title: Oven-Roasted Citrusy Russian Haddock Borscht
description: A show-off Russian dish featuring haddock, pickle, and creamy citrus flavors.
instructions: Rinse the haddock fillets under cold water, pat dry with paper towels, and season with salt and pepper.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, orange juice, and olive oil. Add the beets, carrots, onion, and garlic. Toss to coat.
Transfer the beet-carrot mixture to a large baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Roast in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together sour cream and pickle juice. Set aside.
Remove the beet-carrot mixture from the oven and stir in the chopped fresh dill.
Add the roasted beets and carrots to a blender or food processor with 1/4 cup of water. Blend until smooth.
In a large pot, combine the blended beet-carrot mixture, haddock fillets, and 1 cup of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream-pickle juice mixture and simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with additional chopped fresh dill and a dollop of sour cream if desired.
This dish may be refrigerated or frozen for later use.
